canonical_project: Zhuolang Technology Jiangxi Fuzhou Cloud Computing Big Data Center
owner: Zhuolang Technology / Jiangxi Zhuolang Data Center
notes: Large Fuzhou High-Tech Zone data center on Wang'anshi Avenue. Reported total building area 151,452 sq m, T3/Uptime Tier III and China A-level certifications, first phase operational and second phase near delivery in 2024; sources variously report 4,800 current racks, 4,092 planned in a case page, and up to 10,700 racks at full completion. No MW disclosed.
